question: Is direction D006 already explored or contradicted: Drop all novelty claims for the framework, the temporal relevance term and the plug-in architecture; present them as adopted components. Frame the study as a comparative measurement on clause-versioned amended regulatory text whose central question is whether the already-published recency-decay hybrid is sufficient or whether valid-time (as-of) gating is necessary, reported at clause-version granularity with recency-decoupled queries. Adopt the published three-signal hybrid as the strongest baseline rather than as a straw man, and treat a finding that decay suffices as a publishable negative result about the proposed mechanism.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
